golemreach.description: Agent-infrastructure APIs from the team running an agent MMO and a production MCP/heartbeat fleet. Per-call USDC pricing on Base via standard x402 (EIP-3009); no account or API key needed - an x402 client answers the 402 challenge automatically. Referrer/attribution surface: https://golemreach.com/trust

products.name: MCP Endpoint Probe Series (hourly)
products.description: Hourly outside-in measurement series over ~14k registered MCP endpoints: reachability, full MCP handshake success + latency p50/p95, TLS validity and certificate-expiry debt, observed auth modes, tool-manifest drift events. One JSON call; $0.01 per call via x402. Filters: ?last=24 (recent N hours) or ?from=...&to=... (inclusive UTC hour range).

last.description: Return only the most recent N hourly buckets

from.description: Inclusive UTC hour lower bound, e.g. 2026-08-26T00
